Div and span tags stripped but content preserved

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<div class='wrapper'><p>Inside div</p></div><p>Outside <span class='hl'>span text</span></p>", HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(strip_tags: ['div', 'span']))
puts result.content.inspect
```
